query: Consider Kerber's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document allow the Receiving Party to share some Confidential Information with their employees?
gold: 3. For a period of five (5) years from the date of receiving it, all Confidential Information will be maintained in confidence by the receiving party, will not be disclosed to any third party or to any persons employed in its business other than those having a need to know for the purposes set forth above, and will be protected with the same degree of care as the receiving party normally uses in the protection of its own confidential and proprietary information, but in no case with any less degree than reasonable care.
rag_answer: Yes. Under Section 3, the Receiving Party may share Confidential Information with persons employed in its business only if they have a “need to know” for the purposes set forth in the Agreement. The Receiving Party must also maintain the information in confidence and protect it with at least reasonable care.

judge.gold_summary: 接收方不得向第三方或其业务人员披露机密信息，除非这些人员因协议目的而具有“need to know”；接收方须对机密信息保密，并以不低于合理注意程度的方式保护。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答指出根据第3条，接收方可以向其业务人员分享机密信息，但仅限于这些人员因协议目的而具有“need to know”，并且接收方仍需保密并以至少合理注意程度保护。
judge.reason: 系统回答准确覆盖了金标中的关键要点：允许向员工披露的条件是“need to know”，以及接收方的保密和合理注意义务；虽未提及五年期限，但不影响对是否允许与员工分享这一核心问题的命中。
